title: Final Answer for (a)
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly explain the difference in charge density behavior between the insulating and conducting cylinders, including the condition for similarity.

title: Final Answer for (b)
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct expression for sigma(theta) and the applicable range for E_a.

title: Boundary Conditions
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly state the boundary conditions applied to the potentials inside and outside the cylinder.

title: Use of Gauss' Law
description: Important Criteria: The student must apply Gauss' law correctly to derive the relationship between charge density and electric field.

title: Understanding of Conductors
description: Important Criteria: The student should demonstrate understanding of the electrostatic properties of conductors compared to insulators.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid sign mistakes in the expressions for electric fields and charge densities.

title: Units Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should ensure that all quantities are expressed in consistent units throughout the solution.

title: Mathematical Derivations
description: Optional Criteria: The student may include clear and correct mathematical derivations leading to the final expressions.

title: Physical Interpretation
description: Optional Criteria: The student could provide a physical interpretation of the results, discussing implications of the charge distribution.
